"""Datasets for the full-audit section of the 'Where RR Lose Under Pressure' dashboard."""
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, pathlib
W = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/work"); O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash5"); O.mkdir(exist_ok=True); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rows = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rows, "meta": [{"label": "s28_dash_audit.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rows))
G = pd.read_csv(W / "grid_all.csv")
G["side"] = G.side.str.capitalize()
G["row"] = G.a; G["col"] = G.b; G["phase"] = G.c.fillna("")
G["view"] = G.grid.map({"matchup": "Role x bowler type", "role_phase": "Role x bowler type", "sit_type": "Situation x bowler type", "situation": "Situation", "sit_role": "Situation x batting role"})
sit_all = G[G.grid == "situation"].copy()
for v in ("Situation x bowler type", "Situation x batting role"):
    t = sit_all.copy(); t["view"] = v; t["col"] = "All"; G = pd.concat([G, t])
G.loc[G.grid == "role_phase", "col"] = "All"
G = G[G.grid != "situation"]
G["rr_wins"] = G.rr_raw_wins; G["rr_wins_shrunk"] = G.rr_wins
keep = ["side", "view", "row", "col", "phase", "rr_balls", "league_balls", "rr_wins", "champ_wins", "p_rr_below", "luck_p", "verdict",
        "rr_sr", "ch_sr", "lg_sr", "rr_bpd", "ch_bpd", "lg_bpd", "rr_econ", "ch_econ", "lg_econ", "rr_bpw", "ch_bpw", "lg_bpw"]
G = G.drop(columns=["rr_wins"]).rename(columns={"rr_raw_wins": "rr_wins"})
G["p_rr_below"] = (100 * G.p_rr_below).round(0); G["luck_p"] = (100 * G.luck_p).round(1)
dump("grid", G[keep].round(3), "grid_all.csv (s25_grid.py): IPL 2022-26; RR = 2025-26")
P = pd.read_csv(W / "gaps.csv")
bat = P.side == "Batting"
P["stat1_label"] = np.where(bat, "Strike rate", "Economy"); P["stat2_label"] = np.where(bat, "Balls per dismissal", "Balls per wicket")
for p in ("rr", "ch", "lg"):
    P[p + "_stat1"] = np.where(bat, P[p + "_sr"], P[p + "_econ"]); P[p + "_stat2"] = np.where(bat, P[p + "_bpd"], P[p + "_bpw"])
P["confidence_pct"] = P.rr_below_pct
dump("gaps", P[["rank", "id", "side", "gap", "points_to", "rr_balls", "rr_wins_lost", "confidence_pct", "plain_numbers_agree", "title_relevant",
                "champ_wins_gained", "champ_luck_pct", "stat1_label", "rr_stat1", "ch_stat1", "lg_stat1", "stat2_label", "rr_stat2", "ch_stat2", "lg_stat2"]],
     "gaps.csv (s27_players.py)")
dump("gap_players", pd.read_csv(W / "gap_players.csv"), "gap_players.csv (s27_players.py): IPL 2023-26, any team")
dump("gap_types", pd.read_csv(W / "gap_types.csv"), "gap_types.csv (s27_players.py): IPL 2022-26, every team")
T = pd.read_csv(W / "tree_rules.csv"); T["side"] = T.side.str.capitalize(); T["rr_wins_lost"] = (-T.rr_wins_lost_per_season).round(2)
T["luck_pct"] = (100 * T.luck_p_selection_aware).round(0); T["champ_wins"] = T.champ_wins_per_season.round(2)
dump("tree_rules", T[["side", "rule", "rr_balls", "rr_wins_lost", "luck_pct", "half_sample_negative_pct", "champ_wins"]], "tree_rules.csv (s26_tree.py)")
dump("rr_bat_matrix", pd.read_csv(W / "rr_bat_matrix.csv"), "rr_bat_matrix.csv (s27_players.py): IPL 2023-26, any team")
dump("rr_bowl_matrix", pd.read_csv(W / "rr_bowl_matrix.csv"), "rr_bowl_matrix.csv (s27_players.py): IPL 2023-26, any team")
